plainText:
----
 
 
Full of Summer!! (Japanese: いっぱいサマー！！ Ippai Summer!!) is the fourth Japanese ending theme of Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire. It debuted in AG083, replacing Smile, and ended in AG091, changing back to the previous song.

==Ending animation==
===Synopsis===
It features real-life waves as a background while short clips of and doing summer-related activities play in the foreground. As these clips were taken from previous episodes including old Kanto episodes, there was no new animation footage except the sea.
